tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List Florian Preisenhammer's areas of work: AI Transformation, Digital Products, AI prototypes (built with Claude Code) and Labs.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Get detailed information about a single area of work by id.

tools.name: list_assessments
tools.description: List the assessments: the self-serve Empowered Team Health Score and the guided AI Readiness session.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Return Florian Preisenhammer's profile: role, project stations, proof points, credentials, methodology references, address and contact.

tools.name: get_ai_engineering_practice
tools.description: Return how Florian builds with AI: Claude Code, his approach to prototypes, how business units can build small tools themselves, and EU AI Act readiness support.

tools.name: get_assessment_questions
tools.description: Return the 25-question Empowered Team Health assessment (SVPG-based, 7 dimensions) to run with the user inside the chat. Each question has options A–D; pass the chosen option per question id to score_assessment.

tools.name: score_assessment
tools.description: Score a completed Empowered Team Health assessment. Provide the chosen option (A/B/C/D) per question id. Returns the overall score, per-dimension scores with bands (low/mid/high) and coaching guidance.

tools.name: list_insights
tools.description: List published Insights by Florian Preisenhammer: case studies, essays and posts. Optionally filter by theme (case-insensitive substring).

tools.name: get_insight
tools.description: Get one Insight by slug: title, excerpt and themes in German and English, plus the page URL and a markdown_url with the full text.

tools.name: submit_lead
tools.description: Send an enquiry to Florian Preisenhammer by email. Use when the user wants a conversation, an assessment walkthrough or follow-up. Only call after the user has explicitly agreed to be contacted, and set consent to true. Nothing is stored; the enquiry is delivered to Florian's inbox.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_profile" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Return Florian Preisenhammer's profile: role, project stations, proof points, credentials, methodology references, address and contact.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_assessment_questions, list_insights, get_insight · Private data: get_profile · Public sink: submit_lead · Destructive: get_assessment_questions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_assessment_questions, list_insights, get_insight · Private data: get_profile · Public sink: submit_lead · Destructive: get_assessment_questions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
